summary: Completed backend-only, pure source/compile validation for MIS Incidents & Compliance PDF chart placement. Verified available-series rendering and odd-row padding. Found one behavioral gap when twelve_month_operational_trends is empty: unavailable notice is not shown.

critical.issue: When `twelve_month_operational_trends` is `{}` (no series at all), section renders neither charts nor the explicit unavailable note.

action_items: Update `_sec_incidents_compliance` to show `12-month operational trends unavailable — insufficient approved historical data.` when `twelve_month_operational_trends` is missing/empty, not only when present-but-all-null.
Keep current behavior that charts render only for available `incidents`, `ltifr`, `account_payable_days` series and that odd chart row is padded with Spacer.
critical_code_review_comments: `_sec_incidents_compliance` correctly maps chart specs to `_render_rolling_trend`: incidents(Count,#4f46e5), ltifr(LTIFR,#0f4c81), account_payable_days(Days,#475569).
Current guard `if operational_trends:` prevents fallback notice when dict is empty; this creates a silent blank state instead of explicit unavailable messaging.
`pdf_builder.py` is 703 lines (>700 guideline), consider splitting section builders/chart helpers for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Source-level only run. py_compile passed for pdf_builder.py and service.py. Failing case is deterministic: empty `twelve_month_operational_trends` does not produce unavailable note. Re-run this file after fix.
rca of the issue: RCA: In `_sec_incidents_compliance`, fallback note logic is nested inside `if operational_trends:` and only executes in the `else` branch of `if available:`. For `{}` input, outer condition is false, so no note is emitted. Repro: call section with `report['twelve_month_operational_trends'] = {}`; observe no chart and no notice. Mitigation: treat missing/empty trends as unavailable and render the same note path.
